annotations.title: Retail savings bond sales in Poland (Ministry of Finance)

description: Use for how many savings bonds people buy in Poland, which series sell best, the sum since January against earlier years, IKE and IKZE purchases and buyer age. For bond interest rates and bonds against deposits, use get_retail_bond_premium. Retail savings bonds of the State Treasury sold in Poland per month, from the Ministry of Finance statistics on gov.pl (since January 2015): the latest month in PLN with month-on-month and year-on-year change, the share and amount of every series (OTS, ROR, DOR, TOS, COI, EDO, family ROS and ROD), money from the exchange of maturing bonds and new money, purchases on IKE and IKZE retirement accounts, sales channels, buyer age (natural persons), the sum since January with the rank against the same months of every year, the best month and year, and the finwire index finwire_savings_bond_sales (sales in the 12 months, PLN billion). For interest rates of the current issue use get_retail_bond_premium or get_bank_rates.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.
